4. **Minimax with Alpha-Beta Pruning**: I use a depth-limited search (depth 2-3 depending on time) with alpha-beta pruning to look ahead and evaluate positions. This helps find moves that lead to favorable positions even if they don't look immediately strong.

5. **Move Ordering**: To maximize alpha-beta efficiency, I order moves by a quick heuristic evaluation, examining promising moves first.
